CLADCUT_PAGE_FAQS_ACTION: READY TO IMPROVE YOUR TEAM’S EFFICIENCY? START FREE TRIAL.

answer.text: CladCut is a specialized software solution designed for façade and cladding professionals to automate the preparation of fabrication drawings and machining files, reducing engineering preparation time by up to 85% while significantly improving accuracy and minimizing human errors.

CLADCUT_PAGE_FAQS_SLICE.question: Is CladCut a CNC machine software?

answer.text: No, CladCut is not a CNC operating software. It focuses on the pre-production phase, where it prepares accurate detailed fabrication drawings and machining files (such as DXF). These files are then typically optimized and forwarded to CNC operators for execution on cutting and fabrication machines.
CladCut is built for professionals working in façade and cladding engineering, including:
answer.footer: It is ideal for teams aiming to increase productivity, standardize outputs, and reduce engineering preparation time without compromising precision.

answer.text: CladCut produces a complete set of production-ready outputs, including:
list: Fabrication drawings in PDF, DWG format
Machining files in DXF format (ready for CNC workflow)
Material and cutting data in XLS format
answer.footer: These outputs are structured to support a smooth transition from engineering to fabrication.

CLADCUT_PAGE_FAQS_SLICE.question: How does CladCut improve the cladding fabrication workflow?

answer.text: CladCut automates repetitive and error-prone tasks in the façade detailing process, such as:
list: Preparing panel layouts and cutting details
answer.footer: By doing so, it reduces manual work, minimizes coordination errors, and ensures that fabrication data is directly usable in production.
